source_claim: The official DanMachi series character portal identifies Bell Cranel, Aiz Wallenstein, Liliruca Arde, Eina Tulle, Syr Flover, Ryu Lion, Sanjouno Haruhime, and Yamato Mikoto; the official Sword Oratoria character roster identifies Lefiya Viridis, Riveria Ljos Alf, Tiona Hiryute, and Tione Hiryute as members of the DanMachi's Loki Familia cast.
notes: The official DanMachi Season 4 character portal directly names Bell Cranel, Liliruca Arde, Yamato Mikoto, and Sanjouno Haruhime (https://danmachi.com/danmachi4/character/), and its Season 3 character portal directly profiles Aiz Wallenstein, Eina Tulle, and Syr Flover (https://danmachi.com/danmachi3/character/). The official DanMachi Season 2 cast page names Lyu/Ryu Lion and the members of this production (https://danmachi.com/danmachi2/); the series character portal also profiles Ryu Lion (https://danmachi.com/danmachi4/character/). The official Sword Oratoria site lists Lefiya Viridis, Tiona Hiryute, Tione Hiryute, and Riveria Ljos Alf in the Loki Familia cast and character roster (https://danmachi.com/sword_oratoria/character/), with the official DanMachi movie cast page also identifying Lefiya and the main-series cast together (https://danmachi.com/movie/staff_cast/index.html). The cited pages are official productions based on Fujino Omori's DanMachi novels and list the exact campaign characters; tags use the project's established Latin spellings where Japanese pages render names in Japanese.
